recipes.name: Brown Stew Chicken
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52940. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Squeeze lime over chicken and rub well. Drain off excess lime juice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Combine tomato, scallion, onion, garlic, pepper, thyme, pimento and soy sauce in a large bowl with the chicken pieces. Cover and marinate at least one hour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a dutch pot or large saucepan. Shake off the seasonings as you remove each piece of chicken from the marinade. Reserve the marinade for sauce.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Lightly brown the chicken a few pieces at a time in very hot oil. Place browned chicken pieces on a plate to rest while you brown the remaining pieces.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Drain off excess oil and return the chicken to the pan. Pour the marinade over the chicken and add the carrots. Stir and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Mix flour and coconut milk and add to stew, stirring constantly. Turn heat down to minimum and cook another 20 minutes or until tender.

recipes.name: Callaloo Jamaican Style
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52939. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cut leaves and soft stems from the kale branches, them soak in a bowl of cold water for about 5-10 minutes or until finish with prep.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Proceed to slicing the onions, mincing the garlic and dicing the tomatoes. Set aside

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Remove kale from water cut in chunks.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Place bacon on saucepan and cook until crispy. Then add onions, garlic, thyme, stir for about a minute or more

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Add tomatoes; scotch bonnet pepper, smoked paprika. Sauté for about 2-3 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Finally add vegetable, salt, mix well, and steamed for about 6-8 minutes or until leaves are tender. Add a tiny bit of water as needed. Adjust seasonings and turn off the heat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Using a sharp knife cut both ends off the plantain. This will make it easy to grab the skin of the plantains. Slit a shallow line down the long seam of the plantain; peel only as deep as the peel. Remove plantain peel by pulling it back.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Slice the plantain into medium size lengthwise slices and set aside.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Coat a large frying pan with cooking oil spray. Spray the tops of the plantains with a generous layer of oil spray and sprinkle with salt, freshly ground pepper.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Let the plantains "fry" on medium heat, shaking the frying pan to redistribute them every few minutes.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: As the plantains brown, continue to add more cooking oil spray, salt and pepper (if needed) until they have reached the desired color and texture.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: Remove and serve with kale

recipes.name: Corned Beef and Cabbage – Jamaican Style
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53350. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a skillet or Dutch pot over medium-high heat. Add onion and green pepper and sauté for about 3-5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add garlic and stir for about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add shredded cabbage and stir. Cook for about about 3-5 minutes, stirring often until softened.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add corned beef, Roma tomatoes, and thyme and stir. Add ketchup and scotch bonnet pepper sauce and stir. Reduce heat and cook on medium for about 3-5 minutes, until the corned beef is heated through. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Serve with white rice, bread, or on its own.

recipes.name: Escovitch Fish
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52944. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rinse fish; rub with lemon or lime, seasoned with salt and pepper or use your favorite seasoning. I used creole seasoning. Set aside or place in the oven to keep it warm until sauce is ready.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: In large skillet heat oil over medium heat, until hot, add the fish, cook each side- for about 5-7 minutes until cooked through and crispy on both sides. Remove fish and set aside. Drain oil and leave about 2-3 tablespoons of oil

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add, bay leave, garlic and ginger, stir-fry for about a minute making sure the garlic does not burn

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Then add onion, bell peppers, thyme, scotch bonnet, sugar, all spice-continue stirring for about 2-3 minutes. Add vinegar, mix an adjust salt and pepper according to preference. Let it simmer for about 2 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Discard bay leave, thyme spring and serve over fish with a side of this bammy. You may make the sauce about 2 days in advance.

recipes.name: Jamaican Beef Patties
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52938. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Make the Pastry Dough

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: To a large bowl, add flour, 1 teaspoon salt, and turmeric and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Rub shortening into flour until there are small pieces of shortening completely covered with flour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Pour in 1/2 cup of the ice water and mix with your hands to bring the dough together. Keep adding ice water 2 to 3 tablespoons at a time until the mixture forms a dough.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: At this stage, you can cut the dough into 2 large pieces, wrap in plastic and refrigerate for 30 minutes before using it.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Alternatively, cut the dough into 10 to 12 equal pieces, place on a platter or baking sheet, cover securely with plastic wrap and let chill for 30 minutes while you make the filling.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Make the Filling

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Add ground beef to a large bowl. Sprinkle in allspice and black pepper. Mix together and set aside.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a skillet until hot.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Add onions and sauté until translucent. Add hot pepper, garlic and thyme and continue to sauté for another minute. Add 1/4 teaspoon salt.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Add seasoned ground beef and toss to mix, breaking up any clumps, and let cook until the meat is no longer pink.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: Add ketchup and more salt to taste.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: Pour in 2 cups of water and stir. Bring the mixture to a boil then reduce heat and let simmer until most of the liquid has evaporated and whatever is remaining has reduced to a thick sauce.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.instruction: Fold in green onions. Remove from heat and let cool completely.

recipes.name: Jamaican Curry Chicken Recipe
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53345. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Equipment

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Dutch Oven

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Instructions

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add chicken thighs, all-purpose seasoning, 1 tablespoon of curry powder, onion, green onions, green pepper, garlic cloves, scotch bonnet pepper (if using), and thyme to a large bowl and combine, making sure all chicken pieces are covered with the seasoning. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to overnight.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: One the chicken is done marinating, remove onions, peppers, and garlic cloves from chicken and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a large heavy bottom pot over medium heat. Add remaining curry powder and stir, cooking for about 20-30 seconds. Add onions, green pepper, garlic cloves, thyme, and scotch bonnet pepper (if using) to pot and stir until onions have softened, about 3-5 minutes. If your onions and peppers are looking dry, add about 1 tablespoon of water.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Add chicken and ¼ cup of water to the pot. Cover and reduce heat to medium low. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 30-35 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: When there is about 15 minutes remaining, stir in potato and continue to cook covered.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Once chicken is cooked and potatoes are softened, remove from heat. Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Jamaican Curry Goat
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53354. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Equipment

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 6QT Pressure cooker

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Instructions

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Rinse goat meat with vinegar and water.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Season goat meat with 1 ½ tablespoon curry powder, all-purpose seasoning, ground ginger, allspice, onion, garlic cloves, and thyme. Marinate for at least 4 hours or up to overnight.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Remove onion and garlic from goat and set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Set an electric pressure cooker, like an Instant Pot, on high sauté and add oil. Add goat meat and brown, about 2-3 minutes per side. Remove goat from insert and add 1 tablespoon oil and remaining curry powder and sauté for about 10 seconds. Then add onions and garlic and sauté until softened. About 4 minutes. If the onions look dry, add a little water and continue to sauté.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Add goat and water to the pressure cooker and cover the pressure cooker. Cook for 40 minutes on high pressure. Allow to naturally release for 10 minutes, then release the remaining pressure.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Once all the pressure has been released, open the pressure cooker. Place on sauté for 10-15 minutes, add potatoes and a whole scotch bonnet pepper. Cook until potatoes have softened. Remove scotch bonnet pepper.

recipes.name: Jamaican Curry Shrimp Recipe
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53362. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Season shrimp with 1 Tablespoon of curry powder and all-purpose seasoning and set aside for about 10 minutes while you prepare the other ingredients like chopping your onions, peppers, and garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat 2 Tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add sliced yellow onion, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, scotch bonnet pepper, if using, and chopped garlic and stir for 5 minutes, until peppers are slightly softened.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 Tablespoons of curry powder to the skillet and stir for an additional minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Then add coconut milk, seasoned shrimp, ketchup, and thyme, making sure the shrimp is covered in the sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Allow the sauce to come to a simmer and continue to cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally and flipping the shrimp halfway, until the shrimp is fully cooked on both sides. This should take about 5-6 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Jamaican Pepper Shrimp
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53349. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: In a medium bowl, combine shrimp with minced Scotch Bonnet peppers, all-purpose seasoning, ground annatto, and grounf allspice. Toss well to coat evenly and let marinate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat a large pan over medium heat. Add the shrimp stock and bring to a gentle simmer. Stir in the diced onion and garlic, cooking until softened and fragrant, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add the seasoned shrimp and thyme sprigs, spreading the shrimp in the pan. Cover and cook for about 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the shrimp turn bright orange and are cooked through.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add the white vinegar, stir, and cook for another minute. Taste; add salt to taste. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the shrimp to a plate. Serve hot with some cooking liquid drizzled on top.

recipes.name: Jerk chicken with rice & peas
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52937. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: To make the jerk marinade, combine all the ingredients in a food processor along with 1 tsp salt, and blend to a purée. If you’re having trouble getting it to blend, just keep turning off the blender, stirring the mixture, and trying again. Eventually it will start to blend up – don’t be tempted to add water, as you want a thick paste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Taste the jerk mixture for seasoning – it should taste pretty salty, but not unpleasantly, puckering salty. You can now throw in more chillies if it’s not spicy enough for you. If it tastes too salty and sour, try adding in a bit more brown sugar until the mixture tastes well balanced.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Make a few slashes in the chicken thighs and pour the marinade over the meat, rubbing it into all the crevices. Cover and leave to marinate overnight in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: If you want to barbecue your chicken, get the coals burning 1 hr or so before you’re ready to cook. Authentic jerked meats are not exactly grilled as we think of grilling, but sort of smoke-grilled. To get a more authentic jerk experience, add some wood chips to your barbecue, and cook your chicken over slow, indirect heat for 30 mins. To cook in the oven, heat to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Put the chicken pieces in a roasting tin with the lime halves and cook for 45 mins until tender and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: While the chicken is cooking, prepare the rice & peas. Rinse the rice in plenty of cold water, then tip it into a large saucepan with all the remaining ingredients except the kidney beans. Season with salt, add 300ml cold water and set over a high heat. Once the rice begins to boil, turn it down to a medium heat, cover and cook for 10 mins.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Add the beans to the rice, then cover with a lid. Leave off the heat for 5 mins until all the liquid is absorbed. Squeeze the roasted lime over the chicken and serve with the rice & peas, and some hot sauce if you like it really spicy.

recipes.name: Oxtail with broad beans
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52943. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Toss the oxtail with the onion, spring onion, garlic, ginger, chilli, soy sauce, thyme, salt and pepper. Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Brown the oxtail in the pan until browned all over, about 10 minutes. Place into a pressure cooker, and pour in 375ml water. Cook at pressure for 25 minutes, then remove from heat, and remove the lid according to manufacturer's directions.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add the broad beans and pimento berries, and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Dissolve the cornflour in 2 tablespoons water, and stir into the simmering oxtail. Cook and stir a few minutes until the sauce has thickened, and the broad beans are tender.

recipes.name: Red Peas Soup
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52941. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Wash and rinse the dried kidney beans.. then cover with water in a deep bowl. Remember as they soak they will expand to at least triple the size they were originally so add a lot of water to the bowl. Soak them overnight or for at least 2 hrs to make the cooking step go quicker. I tossed out the water they were soaked in after it did the job.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Have your butcher cut the salted pigtail into 2 inch pieces as it will be very difficult to cut with an ordinary kitchen knife. Wash, then place a deep pot with water and bring to a boil. Cook for 20 minutes, then drain + rinse and repeat (boil again in water). The goal is to make the pieces of pig tails tender and to remove most of the salt it was cured in.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Time to start the soup. Place everything in the pot (except the flour and potato), then cover with water and place on a high flame to bring to a boil. As it comes to a boil, skim off any scum/froth at the top and discard. Reduce the heat to a gentle boil and allow it to cook for 1 hr and 15 mins.. basically until the beans are tender and start falling apart.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: It’s now time to add the potato (and Yams etc if you’re adding it) as well as the coconut milk and continue cooking for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Now is a good time to start making the basic dough for the spinner dumplings. Mix the flour and water (add a pinch of salt if you want) until you have a soft/smooth dough. allow it to rest for 5 minutes, then pinch of a tablespoon at a time and roll between your hands to form a cigarette shape.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Add them to the pot, stir well and continue cooking for another 15 minutes on a rolling boil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: You’ll notice that I didn’t add any salt to the pot as the remaining salt from the salted pigtails will be enough to properly season this dish. However you can taste and adjust accordingly. Lets recap the timing part of things so you’re not confused. Cook the base of the soup for 1 hr and 15 minute or until tender, then add the potatoes and cook for 15 minutes, then add the dumplings and cook for a further 15 minutes. Keep in mind that this soup will thicken quite a bit as it cools.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: While this is not a traditional recipe to any one specific island, versions of this soup (sometimes called stewed peas) can be found throughout the Caribbean, Latin America and Africa. A hearty bowl of this soup will surely give you the sleepies (some may call it ethnic fatigue). You can certainly freeze the leftovers and heat it up another day.

recipes.name: Saltfish and Ackee
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52936. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: For the saltfish, soak the salt cod overnight, changing the water a couple of times.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Drain, then put the cod in a large pan of fresh water and bring to the boil. Drain again, add fresh water and bring to the boil again.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Simmer for about five minutes, or until cooked through, then drain and flake the fish into large pieces. Discard any skin or bones.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: For the dumplings, mix the flour and suet with a pinch of salt and 250ml/9fl oz water to make a dough.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Wrap the mixture in clingfilm and leave in the fridge to rest.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Open the can of ackee, drain and rinse, then set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a pan and fry the onion until softened but not brown.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Add the spices, seasoning, pepper sauce and sliced peppers and continue to fry until the peppers are tender.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Add the chopped tomatoes, then the salt cod and mix together. Lastly stir in the ackee very gently and leave to simmer until ready to serve.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: When you’re almost ready to eat, heat about 1cm/½in vegetable oil in a frying pan and heat until just smoking.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Shape the dumpling mix into plum-size balls and shallow-fry until golden-brown. (CAUTION: hot oil can be dangerous. Do not leave the pan unattended.)

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: Drain the dumplings on kitchen paper and serve with the saltfish and ackee.
